info.title: Payment Operations API — CAP-003
info.description:
Published API contract for the Payment Operations capability (CAP-003). This is the capability-level API — it covers all Direct Debit operations introduced by JRN-012. It extends the existing Payment Operations API surface (Confirmation of Payee and FPS operations from JRN-002 are documented in the faster-payment-initiation model).

This file covers the BACS Direct Debit sub-capability (CAP-003.02): DDI management, collection enquiry, and indemnity claims.

**Architecture rule:** API contracts are per-capability. The channel (SVC-017) and other consumers call this capability API. Internal service routing (SVC-009 as the implementing service) is invisible to consumers.

**Persona interaction pattern:** PER-001 → Channel (SVC-017) → CAP-003 Payment Operations API. Never PER-001 → SVC-009 directly.

**Cross-capability:** CAP-001 (Retail Banking) interactions are exclusively via async events on SVC-102 (Event Bus). This API has no synchronous dependencies on CAP-001.
info.x-architecture-note: API contracts are per-capability (CAP-003), not per-service (SVC-009). Internal service implementation details are not exposed in this contract.

servers.description: Internal API gateway — production. Route: CAP-003 Payment Operations. Not accessible from external networks.

tags.name: Direct Debit Instructions
tags.description: BACS Direct Debit Instruction (DDI) management — setup, enquiry, and cancellation via AUDDIS

tags.name: Indemnity Claims
tags.description: Direct Debit Guarantee indemnity claim filing

post.description:
Creates a DirectDebitInstruction (ENT-034) and initiates AUDDIS 0N submission to BACS. For customer-initiated DDI setup via digital channel only. Originator-initiated DDIs arrive via BACS/AUDDIS directly — not through this API.

**Pre-conditions:**
- Customer session authenticated (OAuth 2.0 Bearer token with direct-debits:write scope)
- SCA completed (FIDO2/WebAuthn or TOTP) — required for mandate authorisation
- Account must be in status = active

**Business rules:**
- Originator SUN must be registered in BACS scheme directory
- No duplicate active DDI for same originator_sun + reference combination on this account
- Account must be eligible for Direct Debits (not a savings account or restricted account)

**Publishes:** EVT-069 (DirectDebitInstructionCreated)

**Returns:** 202 Accepted. DDI is in status = pending. Activation (status = active) occurs asynchronously after BACS AUDDIS confirmation.

202.description: DDI accepted. AUDDIS 0N submission initiated. Poll GET /direct-debits/{ddi_id} for activation status, or await EVT-070 (DirectDebitInstructionValidated) notification.

Location.description: URL of the created DDI resource

400.description: Validation error — invalid request body, originator SUN not recognised, or missing required fields

409.description: Conflict — an active DDI already exists for this originator SUN and reference on this account

example.message: An active Direct Debit instruction already exists for this originator and reference.

422.description: Account not eligible for Direct Debits (e.g. account closed, frozen, or savings account)

get.summary: List Direct Debit Instructions for an account
get.description: Returns all DirectDebitInstruction records (ENT-034) for the authenticated customer's account. Supports filtering by status.

parameters.name: account_id
parameters.description: Account ID to list DDIs for. Must belong to the authenticated customer.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter by DDI status. Defaults to active.

get.summary: Get a Direct Debit Instruction by ID
get.description: Returns the DirectDebitInstruction (ENT-034) for the given ddi_id. The ddi_id must belong to an account owned by the authenticated customer.

404.description: DDI not found or does not belong to authenticated customer

delete.description:
Cancels the DirectDebitInstruction (ENT-034). Updates status = cancelled and submits AUDDIS 0C (cancellation) to BACS. Any pending collections at D-2 status may still be processed by BACS — cancellation does not guarantee prevention of an in-flight collection.

**SCA required** for cancellation via digital channel.

**Publishes:** No specific cancellation event in the JRN-012 catalogue, but ENT-034.status update will be reflected in subsequent GET calls. BACS AUDDIS 0C submission is the authoritative cancellation signal.

sca_assertion_ref.description: SCA assertion reference for digital channel cancellations. Required for PER-001 self-service cancellation.

202.description: Cancellation accepted. AUDDIS 0C submission initiated. DDI status will transition to cancelled after BACS confirmation.

422.description: DDI is already cancelled or in a terminal state

get.summary: List Direct Debit Collections for a DDI
get.description: Returns all DirectDebitCollection records (ENT-035) for the given ddi_id, ordered by collection_date descending.

parameters.name: from_date
parameters.description: Filter collections from this date (inclusive). ISO 8601 date.

post.summary: File an indemnity claim under the Direct Debit Guarantee
post.description:
Files an indemnity claim under the Direct Debit Guarantee for a disputed collection. The bank is obligated to credit the claimed amount to the customer's account **immediately and unconditionally** — no evidence or justification required.

**Regulatory obligation:** The Direct Debit Guarantee requires the bank to act immediately on a customer's indemnity claim. The account credit must be processed within 30 seconds of this call returning 202 Accepted (NFR-JRN012-CC-01).

**Process:**
1. This call creates the claim and publishes EVT-074 (DirectDebitIndemnityClaimFiled)
2. SVC-001 (CAP-001) consumes EVT-074 and credits the account immediately
3. SVC-009 initiates BACS indemnity recovery from the originator
4. If mandate_cancel_requested = true, AUDDIS 0C is submitted to BACS

**Publishes:** EVT-074 (DirectDebitIndemnityClaimFiled)

parameters.name: ddi_id
parameters.description: DDI ID associated with the disputed collection

example.claim_reason: Amount taken was incorrect — I did not authorise this amount

202.description: Indemnity claim accepted. EVT-074 published. Account credit initiated. The claimed_amount will appear in the account within 30 seconds.

400.description: Invalid request — collection_id not found under this DDI, or claimed_amount exceeds collected amount

404.description: DDI or collection not found, or does not belong to authenticated customer

409.description: An indemnity claim has already been filed for this collection_id

example.message: An indemnity claim has already been filed for this collection.

account_id.description: Account to set up the DDI for. Must belong to the authenticated customer and be in status = active.

originator_name.description: Originator organisation name as registered in the BACS scheme. Max 18 characters (BACS field limit).

originator_sun.description: BACS Service User Number (SUN) — 6-digit numeric string.

amount_type.description: Fixed: same amount each collection. Variable: amount may differ per collection.

fixed_amount.description: Required when amount_type = fixed. Collection amount in GBP.

first_collection_date.description: Expected date of first collection. ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD). Optional — informational only.

sca_assertion_ref.description: SCA assertion reference from SVC-100 IAM. Required for digital channel DDI setup. Must be a valid, unused SCA assertion.

status.description: Initial status. Will transition to 'active' after BACS AUDDIS confirmation.

poll_url.description: URL to poll for DDI activation status.

bacs_reference.description: Assigned after BACS AUDDIS confirmation (status = active)

return_reason.description: BACS ARUDD reason code. Present when status = returned.

collection_id.description: DirectDebitCollection (ENT-035) identifier for the disputed collection.

claimed_amount.description: Amount to be refunded. Must be <= the original collected amount. GBP.

claim_reason.description: Customer-provided reason for the claim. Optional — no justification is required under the DD Guarantee.

mandate_cancel_requested.description: If true, the DDI will be cancelled (AUDDIS 0C submitted) as part of processing the claim.

credit_sla.description: Regulatory commitment: account will be credited within 30 seconds.
credit_sla.example: Your account will be credited within 30 seconds under the Direct Debit Guarantee.

mandate_cancellation_status.description: Whether mandate cancellation was requested and initiated.

request_id.description: Request correlation ID for support tracing

BearerAuth.description: OAuth 2.0 Bearer token. Scopes required: direct-debits:write (POST, DELETE), direct-debits:read (GET). Token must be a valid customer session token issued by SVC-100 (IAM).
